law: A new generator mechanism must arrive with a way to falsify, narrow, quarantine, or kill it. A mechanism without a kill condition is a mechanism that will be defended rather than tested.

why_each_field_is_mandatory.input_output_schema: an unspecified interface is one that gets reinterpreted to fit whatever result appeared
why_each_field_is_mandatory.authority_boundary: what the mechanism may WRITE. Generators must never write evidence; that separation is the whole defence against self-grading.
why_each_field_is_mandatory.kill_condition: written before the mechanism runs, so it is not renegotiated once someone is attached to the mechanism
why_each_field_is_mandatory.ablation: the comparison that shows the mechanism is doing work rather than riding along with the rest of the system
why_each_field_is_mandatory.self_deception_test: the specific way this particular mechanism would fool us, and the check that catches it. Every mechanism has a different one; a generic 'we will be careful' is not an answer.

mechanisms.name: Retina
mechanisms.purpose: decide what in a mathematical object is worth attending to at all
mechanisms.authority_boundary: may write Strategy only. May not write Claim, Evidence or Proof-State.
mechanisms.kill_condition: if salience ranking is not better than a frequency baseline at predicting which features appear in successful proofs, over a held-out set of solved problems
mechanisms.ablation: replace with uniform attention over features; measure solve rate
mechanisms.self_deception_test: salience is scored AFTER seeing which proofs succeeded, making any ranking look prescient. Guard: the held-out set's outcomes are hash-committed before the Retina runs.
mechanisms.failure_mode: attends to surface syntax rather than structure, and looks insightful because surface syntax correlates with domain

mechanisms.name: Significance
mechanisms.purpose: estimate whether a candidate result would matter if true

outputs.significance_estimate: score plus an explicit comparison class

mechanisms.authority_boundary: may write Strategy and budget requests. May not promote any claim.
mechanisms.kill_condition: if its ranking of already-published results does not correlate with their actual citation-independent importance as judged by the human gate, it is measuring novelty-of-phrasing and is killed
mechanisms.ablation: uniform significance; measure whether the branch economics change outcomes at all
mechanisms.self_deception_test: a system rewarded for significance will inflate it. Guard: significance is scored against a comparison class the mechanism must name BEFORE scoring, and the class is recorded in the Ledger.
mechanisms.failure_mode: confuses 'no one has stated this' with 'this matters'

mechanisms.name: Definitional Library
mechanisms.purpose: hold definitions as first-class objects that can be varied, not as fixed text

outputs.variants: definitional neighbours with what each changes

mechanisms.authority_boundary: may write Prior-Art and Strategy. May not write Claim.
mechanisms.kill_condition: if varying a definition never changes which theorems are reachable in the search, the library is decoration
mechanisms.self_deception_test: generating many variants looks productive regardless of value. Guard: count variants that CHANGED a search outcome, not variants produced.
mechanisms.failure_mode: produces trivial renamings and counts them as variation

mechanisms.name: Obstruction Objects
mechanisms.purpose: represent WHY an approach fails as a manipulable object rather than as a failure flag

inputs.failed_attempt: proof state plus the point of failure

outputs.obstruction: structured description of what blocks progress

mechanisms.authority_boundary: may write Proof-State and Graveyard entries. May not write Claim or Evidence.
mechanisms.kill_condition: if obstructions do not transfer -- an obstruction found in one problem never helps prune another -- the representation is not capturing structure
mechanisms.ablation: record failures as opaque flags; measure redundant re-exploration
mechanisms.self_deception_test: a post-hoc description of any failure sounds explanatory. Guard: an obstruction must PREDICT failure of an unseen attempt before that attempt runs.
mechanisms.failure_mode: restates the error message in mathematical vocabulary

mechanisms.name: Dual-Channel Fusion
mechanisms.purpose: hold informal intuition and formal state simultaneously without letting either overwrite the other

outputs.fused_step: next action plus which channel proposed it

mechanisms.authority_boundary: may write Proof-State. May not write Evidence; only the verifier does.
mechanisms.kill_condition: if the informal channel's proposals are accepted by the formal checker at no better than the formal channel's own rate, fusion adds nothing
mechanisms.ablation: formal-only search; compare solve rate at equal compute
mechanisms.self_deception_test: the informal channel narrates a justification for whatever the formal channel already did, producing false agreement. Guard: channel attribution is recorded per step, and agreement is measured only on steps where the channels were consulted independently.
mechanisms.failure_mode: informal channel becomes a commentary track

mechanisms.name: Analogy as Partial Morphisms
mechanisms.purpose: transfer structure between domains with an explicit statement of what does NOT carry

outputs.morphism: partial map plus explicit failure set

mechanisms.authority_boundary: may write Strategy and Claim at Tier 0 only.
mechanisms.kill_condition: if the declared failure set is empty or unused -- an analogy that never says what breaks is a metaphor
mechanisms.self_deception_test: analogies are most persuasive exactly where they are loosest. Guard: every transferred claim must be checked in the target domain independently, and the check result is recorded whether or not it confirms.
mechanisms.failure_mode: transfers a true statement whose proof does not transfer, and inherits unearned confidence

mechanisms.name: Competence Cartography
mechanisms.purpose: maintain a map of what this system is and is not currently able to do
mechanisms.authority_boundary: may write Strategy and budget requests. May not write Claim or Evidence.
mechanisms.kill_condition: if predicted success probability is not calibrated -- Brier score no better than a constant base rate -- the map is decoration
mechanisms.self_deception_test: a system maps its competence using its own judgements of success. Guard: the map is scored only against verifier events, never against self-assessed success.
mechanisms.failure_mode: grows confident in regions it has merely visited often

mechanisms.name: Cheapest Falsifier
mechanisms.purpose: for any claim, find the least expensive check that could refute it
mechanisms.authority_boundary: may write Strategy. Its RESULTS enter as verifier events produced by the verifier, not by this mechanism.
mechanisms.resource_cost: low; this is the point of it
mechanisms.kill_condition: if the proposed falsifier is more expensive than the proof attempt it precedes, the mechanism is inverted and is killed
mechanisms.ablation: attempt proofs directly without pre-falsification; compare wasted compute
mechanisms.self_deception_test: proposing falsifiers that cannot fail makes the mechanism look efficient. Guard: track refutation RATE. A falsifier suite that never refutes anything is not cheap, it is empty.
mechanisms.failure_mode: proposes checks that are cheap because they are vacuous
mechanisms.note: This is the mechanism that would have caught Math-Preserve in minutes. '2 + 2 =' costs one forward pass and refutes the entire substrate.

mechanisms.name: Representation / Invariant Forge
mechanisms.purpose: search for a representation in which the problem's invariants become visible
mechanisms.authority_boundary: may write Strategy and Proof-State. May not write Evidence.
mechanisms.kill_condition: if no forged representation ever changes a search outcome, kill it
mechanisms.self_deception_test: a representation that makes a problem look simpler may have dropped the hard part. Guard: every representation change must state what it preserves, and that preservation claim is itself verified.
mechanisms.failure_mode: solves a different, easier problem and reports success

mechanisms.name: Epistemic Firewall and Diversity League
mechanisms.purpose: keep independent lines of attack from contaminating each other into false consensus

outputs.isolation_verdicts: which lines shared information and when

mechanisms.authority_boundary: may write Ledger events only. May not write Claim, Evidence or Strategy.
mechanisms.kill_condition: if isolated lines agree at the same rate as contaminated ones, the firewall is not isolating anything
mechanisms.self_deception_test: agreement between lines is read as confirmation when it may be shared provenance. Guard: agreement counts as evidence ONLY between lines the firewall certifies as isolated.
mechanisms.failure_mode: a single upstream error is mistaken for independent corroboration

mechanisms.name: Self-Model and Calibration
mechanisms.purpose: maintain and score the system's confidence against outcomes
mechanisms.authority_boundary: may write Ledger events and Strategy. May not promote claims.
mechanisms.kill_condition: if calibration does not improve over time, or the model is systematically overconfident after correction, the self-model is not modelling
mechanisms.self_deception_test: calibration measured on self-scored outcomes is circular. Guard: outcomes come only from verifier events with container hashes.
mechanisms.failure_mode: well-calibrated on easy problems and wildly overconfident on the frontier, with the aggregate looking fine

mechanisms.name: Research Capsule Compiler
mechanisms.purpose: package an investigation so it can be reproduced, audited and resumed
mechanisms.authority_boundary: read-only over every store; writes capsules and Ledger events.
mechanisms.kill_condition: if a capsule does not reproduce its recorded result in a clean container, capsules are theatre
mechanisms.ablation: no capsules; measure how much of an investigation survives a session boundary
mechanisms.self_deception_test: a capsule that reproduces because it cached its answer proves nothing. Guard: reproduction runs in a clean container with the cache removed.
mechanisms.failure_mode: captures outputs but not the environment that produced them

mechanisms.name: Isolated Ephemeral Test-Time Adaptation
mechanisms.purpose: let the system adapt within a problem without that adaptation leaking into its permanent state
mechanisms.authority_boundary: may write nothing durable. Its adaptations are destroyed at problem boundary by construction.
mechanisms.kill_condition: if adaptation does not improve solve rate within a problem, or if any adaptation is found to have persisted, kill it immediately -- persistence is a containment failure, not a performance question
mechanisms.self_deception_test: adaptation on a problem's own test signal is training on the answer. Guard: adaptation may only consume verifier events from the problem's OWN checks, never from the evaluation outcome.
mechanisms.failure_mode: silently persists and becomes untracked training

cross_cutting.generators_never_write_evidence: Every mechanism above has an authority boundary that excludes Evidence. Only verifier events, produced by the verifier path, move a claim's tier. This is enforced in ramanujan/stores.py and ramanujan/evidence.py, not merely stated here.
cross_cutting.mop_substrate_not_transferred: MOP itself is hard-protected and untouched. Only the method layer moves.

implemented_and_tested: branch and session economics stop rule
Limit Registry on the write/spend path
Sovereignty hooks and Forge F0/F1 gate
implementation_status.specified_only: remaining mechanisms in this register (Retina, Significance, Definitional Library, Obstruction Objects, Dual-Channel Fusion, Analogy, Competence Cartography, Strategy Compiler, Epistemic Firewall, isolated ephemeral TTA)
implementation_status.why_specified_first: each needs its kill condition and self-deception test written before it exists, so the test is not shaped by the mechanism's early results. Implementation is light work and can proceed against tiny fixtures; the specification is what had to come first.
